description.zh:
随机上线 —— 让 AI 像真人一样，在你沉默时主动找你说话。你越久没说话，它上线的概率越高；它会在某个随机时刻自己出现，发一条主动消息。

装好之后：
· 侧边栏能看到当前唤醒概率、下次大概什么时候可能上线
· 可以随时手动触发一次唤醒，不用等概率
· 静默时段可分开设（白天段 / 夜间段），支持节假日、学生模式、指定日期免打扰
· 三组共 11 项提示词与话术都能自己改，不喜欢的就换
· 可选与「温柔巡检」联动，语气随它的醋意变化（A2 发送方式）

安装、更新、API 与实现细节都在开源仓库：https://github.com/what-my-names/on_air

v2.2.2（正式版）
description.en:
On Air — let your AI come to you like a real person. The longer you stay silent, the higher the chance it shows up with a message of its own.

What you get:
· Sidebar shows the current wake-up chance and roughly when it may come online
· Trigger a wake-up manually at any time
· Quiet hours with separate day/night windows, plus holidays, student mode and per-date mute
· All 11 prompts and talk lines are editable
· Optional integration with Gentle Guardian so its tone follows its jealousy (A2 send mode)

Install, update notes, API and implementation details: https://github.com/what-my-names/on_air

2.2.2 (stable)
